long_biography.plain_text:
Taking over Deep Impact gave Mark Fischer an existing boatbuilding business to reshape. He retained the hull design developed by John Cosker while changing decks, consoles and cabins to suit customers more closely. Working with the factory team, he expanded the range and paid particular attention to how people would use the space on board.

Fischer’s practical familiarity with the water began on Long Island, where he worked as a teenage clam fisherman. He later sold boats in the Florida Keys before acquiring Deep Impact. He tests its boats himself, while his wife Eileen contributes ideas about comfort and liveability.

confidence.reason: The current owners page supports personal testing and Eileen's contribution; the 2026 first-person interview and Speedboat profile support retained Cosker hull design, layout changes and the dealer background.
